generic.Defined scope/population: All entity minute book folders held in OpenText Document Mgmt
generic.In-scope period: Current minute book version and all prior amended pages on file
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Folder ACL, read-only flag, and version-stamp fields set for each entry
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Restricted-folder count matches the active legal entity count in the index
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Access-control change log entry with date, editor and reason retained
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unrestricted folder or missing version stamp logged with remediation owner
generic.Test population: Sample of 10 minute book folders across active legal entities
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled folders restricted to Corporate Secretary/Legal Ops and read-only
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to Records Manager for immediate ACL correction and re-test
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every finalized minute book page is read-only, version-stamped and access-restricted
generic.Evidence location: Governance change log and OpenText access-control audit report

steps.title: Restrict minute book folder access in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Open the minute book folder for the legal entity in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Set folder permissions to Corporate Secretary and Legal Operations staff only.
Remove any legacy or shared group access broader than required.
Done when the folder ACL lists only authorized Corporate Secretary/Legal Ops accounts.
verify: Pull the folder permission report from OpenText for the entity.
Pass when only authorized roles appear on the access list.

steps.title: Set finalized minute book pages to read-only
sop: Identify each minute book page finalized after the resolution or minutes are signed.
Apply the read-only attribute in OpenText to lock the finalized page.
Confirm check-out/edit is disabled for the locked page.
Done when every finalized page shows the read-only flag active.
verify: Attempt a test edit on a sampled finalized page.
Pass when the system blocks the edit and shows read-only status.

steps.title: Version-stamp amended minute book pages
sop: Open each amended minute book page requiring a version update.
Stamp the page with editor name, date and reason for revision in metadata.
Confirm the prior version is retained in version history, not overwritten.
Done when every amended page carries a complete version stamp.
verify: Review version history for a sample of amended pages.
Pass when editor, date and reason appear for each amendment.

steps.title: Require check-out before minute book edits
sop: Confirm check-out/check-in is enabled at the minute book folder level.
Test that a direct edit without check-out is rejected by the system.
Confirm check-out logs the user and timestamp automatically.
Done when check-out is enforced for every minute book entry.
verify: Attempt an edit without checking out the document first.
Pass when the system rejects the edit and requires check-out.

steps.title: Log the access-control configuration change
sop: Record the folder, prior access setting and new restriction in the governance change log.
Note the date of change and the approver authorizing the restriction.
File the change log entry in the Microsoft 365 / SharePoint governance tracker.
Done when the change log entry is complete and saved.
verify: Open the governance change log and locate the entry.
Pass when the entry records folder, date, prior state and approver.

steps.title: Reconcile restricted-folder count to entity index
sop: Pull the count of access-restricted minute book folders from OpenText.
Compare the count against the total number of active legal entities in the records index.
Investigate and correct any entity missing a restricted folder.
Done when the restricted-folder count matches the entity count.
verify: Compare the two counts side by side.
Pass when counts match with no entity left unrestricted.

steps.title: Sample test the full access-control configuration
sop: Select a sample of 10 minute book folders across active legal entities.
Confirm each shows correct ACL, read-only status and version stamping.
Log any exception found with a remediation owner and due date.
Done when the sample is fully tested and exceptions are logged.
verify: Review the sample results and exception log.
Pass when 100% of the sample passes or has a logged remediation owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All corporate records due for archival across legal entities
generic.In-scope period: Current filing cycle plus any backlog awaiting classification
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention classification, entity tag and archive location fields set
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived record count matches the count logged in the corporate records index
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive location and box/folder reference recorded with archive date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any record with ambiguous classification logged with resolution owner
generic.Test population: Sample of 15 recently archived records across retention classes
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled records carry correct retention class and entity tag
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate misclassified records to Legal Operations Manager for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every archived record is tagged, classified and indexed per the retention schedule
generic.Evidence location: Corporate records index and OpenText archive folder

steps.title: Tag record with retention classification at filing
sop: Review the record type against the enterprise retention schedule categories.
Apply the permanent, 7-year or litigation-hold tag in the OpenText metadata field.
Confirm the tag matches the schedule category, not a default guess.
Done when the record carries a definitive retention classification.
verify: Open the record metadata and check the tag value.
Pass when the tag matches the schedule category for that record type.

steps.title: Flag permanent records as non-destructible
sop: Identify articles, bylaws and minute book records among the batch.
Set the non-destructible flag on each permanent record in the records index.
Confirm the flag blocks the record from any destruction workflow.
Done when all permanent records show the non-destructible flag.
verify: Query the index for permanent-category records missing the flag.
Pass when zero permanent records lack the non-destructible flag.

steps.title: File the record under the correct entity folder
sop: Confirm the legal entity name on the record matches an active entity folder.
Move or file the record into that entity's corporate records repository folder.
Verify no record is filed under a wrong or discontinued entity folder.
Done when the record sits in the correct entity's repository folder.
verify: Open the entity folder and confirm the record is present.
Pass when the record is filed under the correct legal entity.

steps.title: Cross-reference the record against the retention schedule
sop: Pull the enterprise retention schedule for the record's category.
Compare the applied classification against the schedule's prescribed category.
Correct any mismatch found before finalizing the archive entry.
Done when the classification matches the retention schedule.
verify: Re-check the classification against the schedule for a sample of records.
Pass when classification and schedule category agree for every sampled record.

steps.title: Record the archive location in the corporate records index
sop: Enter the archive location or box/folder reference in the corporate records index.
Confirm the reference is specific enough to enable direct retrieval.
Link the index entry back to the entity's records folder.
Done when the archive location is logged in the index.
verify: Search the index for the archived record.
Pass when the archive location reference resolves to the correct record.

steps.title: Reconcile archived count against the index
sop: Pull the total archived-record count for the period from OpenText.
Compare it to the count of new entries added to the corporate records index.
Investigate any gap between the two counts.
Done when the archived count reconciles to the index entries.
verify: Compare the two counts for the archival period.
Pass when counts match with no unexplained variance.

steps.title: Sample test archived records for classification accuracy
sop: Select 15 recently archived records spanning all retention classes.
Confirm each carries correct classification, entity tag and archive location.
Log any exception with a remediation owner.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review the sample results and any exceptions.
Pass when 100% of the sample is correctly tagged or has a logged remediation owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All resolution certification requests from external and regulatory parties
generic.In-scope period: Certification requests logged in the current secretarial filings cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requesting party, purpose and certification date fields completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certification register count matches issued certificates on file
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certified copy retained with issue date and Corporate Secretary seal image
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any mismatched resolution text logged and corrected before issuance
generic.Test population: Sample of 8 certifications issued in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled certifications match minute book text word-for-word
generic.Exception handling path: Return to Corporate Secretary for correction before re-issuance
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certification matches minute book, bears seal, and is logged in the register
generic.Evidence location: Secretarial filings register and OpenText certification folder

steps.title: Match certification text to the minute book entry
sop: Pull the executed resolution from the minute book in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Compare the certification draft word-for-word against the minute book entry.
Correct any discrepancy in wording before proceeding.
Done when the certification text matches the minute book exactly.
verify: Re-read the certification against the source minute book entry.
Pass when every word matches with no discrepancy.

steps.title: Affix certification statement and corporate seal
sop: Apply the standard Corporate Secretary certification statement to the document.
Affix the corporate seal to the certified copy.
Sign and date the certification.
Done when the certified copy bears the statement, seal and signature.
verify: Inspect the certified copy for statement, seal and signature.
Pass when all three are present and legible.

steps.title: Log requesting party and purpose on the certification request
sop: Record the requesting bank, regulator or counterparty name on the request.
Record the stated purpose of the certification request.
Confirm the requester is a legitimate party entitled to receive it.
Done when requester and purpose are logged on the request record.
verify: Open the request record and check requester and purpose fields.
Pass when both fields are complete and accurate.

steps.title: Route for General Counsel countersignature via DocuSign
sop: Determine whether the requesting institution requires General Counsel countersignature.
Send the certified copy to General Counsel for signature through DocuSign.
Confirm the countersignature is captured before release.
Done when the required countersignature is complete or noted as not required.
verify: Check the DocuSign envelope status for the countersignature.
Pass when the countersignature is present or waiver is documented.

steps.title: Log the certification in the secretarial filings register
sop: Enter the certification, date issued and recipient into the secretarial filings register.
Attach a copy of the issued certification to the register entry.
Confirm the register entry number is sequential and unique.
Done when the register entry is complete and saved.
verify: Search the register for the new entry.
Pass when date issued, recipient and attached copy are all present.

steps.title: Reconcile certification register to issued certificates
sop: Pull the count of certifications logged in the register for the period.
Compare the count against certified copies stored in OpenText.
Investigate any certification issued but not logged, or logged but not issued.
Done when the register count matches the issued certificate count.
verify: Compare register entries to stored certified copies.
Pass when counts match with no unexplained variance.

steps.title: Sample test issued certifications for accuracy
sop: Select 8 certifications issued during the period.
Confirm each matches its source minute book entry and carries the seal.
Log any exception with a corrective action.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review sample results against source minutes.
Pass when 100% match or have a logged corrective action.

generic.Defined scope/population: All executed board and committee resolutions pending minute book filing
generic.In-scope period: Resolutions executed since the last minute book filing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signature type, meeting tab and sequence number fields completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed resolution count matches agenda items requiring a resolution
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed resolution retained with sequence number and filing date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unsigned or uncertified resolution logged and held from filing
generic.Test population: Sample of 10 resolutions filed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled resolutions correctly sequenced and cross-referenced to agenda
generic.Exception handling path: Return unsigned resolution to Corporate Secretary for execution before filing
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Resolution filed under correct meeting tab, sequenced, and reflected in table of contents
generic.Evidence location: Minute book entity folder in OpenText and meeting agenda archive

steps.title: Confirm resolution bears original or certified signatures
sop: Pull the executed resolution document from the signing workflow.
Verify it bears original wet-ink or DocuSign-certified signatures.
Reject and return any resolution missing a valid signature.
Done when the resolution's signature is confirmed valid.
verify: Inspect the signature block or DocuSign certificate.
Pass when a valid original or certified signature is present.

steps.title: File the resolution behind the correct meeting tab
sop: Identify the board or committee meeting the resolution corresponds to.
File the resolution behind that meeting's tab in the entity minute book in OpenText.
Confirm no resolution is filed under the wrong meeting tab.
Done when the resolution sits behind the correct meeting tab.
verify: Open the meeting tab and confirm the resolution is present.
Pass when the resolution is filed under the correct meeting.

steps.title: Sequence-number the resolution
sop: Determine the next sequential number in the minute book's existing numbering scheme.
Apply the sequence number to the filed resolution.
Confirm no gap or duplicate number is introduced.
Done when the resolution carries the correct sequence number.
verify: Review the minute book sequence for gaps or duplicates.
Pass when the sequence is unbroken and unique.

steps.title: Cross-reference resolution to its meeting agenda item
sop: Pull the board/committee meeting agenda for the corresponding date.
Confirm the resolution matches the agenda item it resolves.
Note the agenda item reference on the resolution filing.
Done when the resolution is cross-referenced to its agenda item.
verify: Compare the resolution to the cited agenda item.
Pass when the resolution content matches the agenda item description.

steps.title: Update the minute book table of contents
sop: Add the newly filed resolution's title, date and sequence number to the table of contents.
Confirm the entry links correctly to the filed page.
Verify no prior table of contents entry was overwritten.
Done when the table of contents reflects the new filing.
verify: Open the table of contents and locate the new entry.
Pass when the entry accurately reflects the filed resolution.

steps.title: Reconcile filed resolutions against the agenda item list
sop: Pull all agenda items requiring a resolution for the period.
Compare against the resolutions actually filed in the minute book.
Investigate any agenda item without a corresponding filed resolution.
Done when every resolution-requiring agenda item is reconciled.
verify: Compare the agenda item list to filed resolutions.
Pass when no unresolved agenda items requiring a resolution remain.

steps.title: Sample test filed resolutions for sequencing accuracy
sop: Select 10 resolutions filed in the period.
Confirm correct sequencing, meeting tab and table of contents linkage.
Log any exception found with a correction owner.
Done when the sample is tested and exceptions logged.
verify: Review the sample results.
Pass when 100% pass or have a logged correction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every legal entity in the current entity inventory
generic.In-scope period: Annual meeting minutes and filings for the review period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Minute book completeness, officer roster match and review findings fields
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entity count in inventory matches minute books reviewed
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed annual review memo retained with review date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing resolutions or filing gaps logged with owner and due date
generic.Test population: All active legal entities in the entity inventory
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of entities have a complete minute book with no unresolved gaps
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate unresolved gaps to Legal Operations Manager for remediation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review memo signed with findings and remediation owners documented
generic.Evidence location: Annual review memo archive in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint

steps.title: Confirm every legal entity has a minute book on file
sop: Pull the current entity inventory list.
Confirm a corresponding minute book exists in OpenText for each entity.
Flag any entity missing a minute book.
Done when every entity's minute book presence is confirmed.
verify: Cross-check the inventory list against OpenText minute book folders.
Pass when every entity has a matching minute book.

steps.title: Verify minute books contain a complete set of annual minutes
sop: Review each minute book for the review period's annual meeting minutes.
Confirm no gaps exist between scheduled meetings and filed minutes.
Note any missing minutes for follow-up.
Done when completeness is confirmed or gaps are documented.
verify: Compare the meeting calendar to filed minutes for each entity.
Pass when no unexplained gap remains.

steps.title: Check officer and director rosters against filed minutes
sop: Pull the current officer and director roster from the records system.
Compare it against the most recently filed minutes' elected officers.
Flag any discrepancy in names, titles or effective dates.
Done when the roster is confirmed consistent with filed minutes.
verify: Review the roster-to-minutes comparison.
Pass when no unresolved discrepancy remains.

steps.title: Document review findings with owners and due dates
sop: Compile missing resolutions, unsigned consents and filing gaps found during the review.
Assign an owner and due date to each finding.
Enter findings into the annual review memo.
Done when all findings are documented with owner and due date.
verify: Review the memo's findings section.
Pass when every finding has an assigned owner and due date.

steps.title: Obtain Corporate Secretary sign-off on the review memo
sop: Finalize the annual review memo with all findings and remediation plans.
Review the completed memo for accuracy.
Sign and date the memo.
Done when the memo is signed and filed in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint.
verify: Open the filed memo and check for signature and date.
Pass when the memo is signed and archived.

steps.title: Reconcile entity count between inventory and reviewed minute books
sop: Pull the total entity count from the inventory.
Compare against the number of minute books reviewed in the cycle.
Investigate and resolve any variance.
Done when the counts reconcile.
verify: Compare the two counts.
Pass when counts match with no entity left unreviewed.

steps.title: Track remediation of findings to closure
sop: Follow up on each finding's assigned owner and due date.
Confirm remediation action is completed and evidenced.
Update the review memo with closure status.
Done when all findings are closed or have a documented extension.
verify: Review the closure status of each finding.
Pass when all findings are closed or extended with justification.

generic.Defined scope/population: All routine corporate actions proposed for unanimous written consent
generic.In-scope period: Consent actions raised in the current governance cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Bylaw eligibility check, signatory list and effective date fields completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Signatures captured match required signatory count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Fully executed consent retained with DocuSign completion certificate
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any consent lacking bylaw eligibility logged and converted to a meeting
generic.Test population: Sample of 6 consents filed in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled consents fully executed before filing
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate incomplete signature sets to Legal Counsel for follow-up
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Consent fully executed, filed in the minute book, and logged in the action calendar
generic.Evidence location: Minute book entity folder and corporate action calendar

steps.title: Confirm consent eligibility under the bylaws
sop: Review the bylaws' provision for unanimous written consent in lieu of meetings.
Confirm the proposed action qualifies for consent rather than a meeting.
Flag any action that does not qualify.
Done when eligibility is confirmed or the action is redirected to a meeting.
verify: Check the bylaw citation against the proposed action.
Pass when eligibility is documented and correct.

steps.title: Circulate the consent for e-signature via DocuSign
sop: Prepare the consent document with the resolution language.
Send the consent for e-signature to every entitled director/committee member via DocuSign.
Track the signing status of each recipient.
Done when the consent is circulated to all required signatories.
verify: Check the DocuSign envelope recipient list.
Pass when every entitled signatory is included in the circulation.

steps.title: Verify all required signatures are captured
sop: Monitor the DocuSign envelope for completed signatures.
Confirm every required signatory has signed before treating the consent as effective.
Follow up with any outstanding signatory.
Done when all required signatures are captured.
verify: Review the DocuSign completion certificate.
Pass when 100% of required signatories have signed.

steps.title: File the executed consent in the minute book
sop: Download the fully executed consent from DocuSign.
File it in the entity's minute book in OpenText in place of meeting minutes.
Confirm the filing replaces the placeholder for that action.
Done when the executed consent is filed in the minute book.
verify: Open the minute book and confirm the consent is filed.
Pass when the consent appears in place of meeting minutes for that action.

steps.title: Log the consent's effective date in the corporate action calendar
sop: Determine the consent's effective date per its terms or last signature date.
Enter the effective date and action description into the corporate action calendar.
Confirm the calendar entry links to the filed consent.
Done when the effective date is logged in the calendar.
verify: Open the corporate action calendar and locate the entry.
Pass when the effective date and linkage are correct.

steps.title: Sample test filed consents for complete execution
sop: Select 6 consents filed during the period.
Confirm each is fully executed and correctly filed.
Log any exception with a follow-up action.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review the sample against DocuSign completion records.
Pass when 100% are fully executed or have a logged follow-up.

generic.Defined scope/population: All legal entity records in the electronic corporate records system
generic.In-scope period: Ownership, officer and director changes since the last update cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Officer, director and shareholder-of-record fields current and complete
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Electronic ownership percentages reconcile to the stock ledger
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Supporting resolution or filing document attached to each entity record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing field flags cleared or logged with a remediation owner
generic.Test population: Sample of 12 entity records updated in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled entity records current and reconciled to source filings
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate reconciliation breaks to Records Manager for correction
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entity data completeness report clears with no unresolved missing fields
generic.Evidence location: Electronic corporate records system entity profile and completeness report

steps.title: Update entity record for officer, director or shareholder changes
sop: Identify any new officer, director or shareholder-of-record change reported.
Update the entity record in the system within 5 business days.
Confirm the change reflects the correct effective date.
Done when the entity record shows the current change.
verify: Open the entity record and check the update timestamp.
Pass when the change is reflected within 5 business days of the event.

steps.title: Reconcile electronic ownership percentages to the stock ledger
sop: Pull ownership percentages from the electronic corporate records system.
Compare against the most recent stock ledger entries.
Correct any variance found between the two sources.
Done when ownership percentages reconcile to the stock ledger.
verify: Compare system percentages to ledger entries.
Pass when both sources agree with no unresolved variance.

steps.title: Confirm registered agent and address fields match state filings
sop: Pull the current registered agent name and principal office address from the system.
Compare against the most recent Secretary of State filing for the entity.
Correct any mismatch found.
Done when the fields match the current state filings.
verify: Compare system fields to the Secretary of State record.
Pass when the fields agree with the state filing.

steps.title: Attach supporting resolution or filing document to the entity record
sop: Identify the resolution or filing document supporting the recorded change.
Attach the document to the corresponding entity record in OpenText.
Confirm the attachment is legible and correctly linked.
Done when the supporting document is attached to the record.
verify: Open the entity record and confirm the attachment.
Pass when the correct supporting document is present and linked.

steps.title: Run the entity data completeness report
sop: Generate the entity data completeness report from the records system.
Review flagged missing fields across all entities.
Clear each flagged field by completing or correcting the data.
Done when the completeness report shows no unresolved flags.
verify: Re-run the completeness report after corrections.
Pass when zero flagged missing fields remain.

steps.title: Sample test entity records for currency and reconciliation
sop: Select 12 entity records updated during the period.
Confirm each reconciles to source filings and ledger entries.
Log any exception with a remediation owner.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review sample results against source filings.
Pass when 100% reconcile or have a logged remediation owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All official minute books for each legal entity
generic.In-scope period: Minutes, resolutions and consents executed since the last filing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Entity minute book tab, filing date and table of contents fields current
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed items count matches the meeting calendar's scheduled meetings
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed minutes, resolutions and consents retained in chronological order
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing minutes for a scheduled meeting logged with follow-up owner
generic.Test population: Sample of 10 legal entity minute books
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled minute books current with no missing filings
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate missing filings to Corporate Secretary for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minute book current with all executed minutes, resolutions and consents filed in order
generic.Evidence location: OpenText entity minute book folder and meeting calendar

steps.title: Confirm each entity has a dedicated minute book tab
sop: Review the minute book structure in OpenText for each legal entity.
Confirm each entity has its own dedicated tab or binder.
Correct any commingling of entities within a single tab.
Done when every entity has a dedicated, uncommingled minute book tab.
verify: Spot-check tabs for cross-entity commingling.
Pass when no entity's records are commingled with another's.

steps.title: File signed minutes, resolutions and consents chronologically
sop: Collect signed minutes, resolutions and consents pending filing.
File each within 10 business days of execution in chronological order.
Confirm no item is filed out of date sequence.
Done when all pending items are filed in chronological order.
verify: Review the filing dates against execution dates.
Pass when all items are filed within 10 business days in correct order.

steps.title: Update the minute book table of contents on each filing
sop: Add each newly filed item to the minute book table of contents.
Confirm the entry links to the correct page.
Verify no entry is missing after a filing.
Done when the table of contents reflects every filed item.
verify: Compare filed items to table of contents entries.
Pass when every filed item has a corresponding entry.

steps.title: Confirm bylaws and articles copy is the latest amended version
sop: Pull the current bylaws and articles of incorporation copy from the front of the minute book.
Compare against the most recently amended version on file.
Replace with the current version if outdated.
Done when the front-of-book copy is the latest amended version.
verify: Compare the front-of-book copy to the amendment history.
Pass when the copy matches the latest amendment.

steps.title: Reconcile the minute book against the meeting calendar
sop: Pull the meeting calendar for the entity's board and committees.
Confirm every scheduled meeting has corresponding minutes filed.
Flag any scheduled meeting missing minutes.
Done when the minute book reconciles to the meeting calendar.
verify: Compare the calendar to the minute book's filed minutes.
Pass when no scheduled meeting lacks filed minutes.

steps.title: Sample test minute books for completeness
sop: Select 10 legal entity minute books.
Confirm each is current with minutes, resolutions and consents filed.
Log any exception with a follow-up owner.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review sample results.
Pass when 100% are current or have a logged exception owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: Stock certificate register and ownership ledger for each legal entity

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any reconciliation break with Finance's equity records logged and resolved

generic.Exception handling path: Escalate ledger-to-Finance mismatches to Governance Analyst for resolution
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ledger reconciled to authorized shares with certificate-level detail current

steps.title: Record certificate issuance, transfer or cancellation
sop: Identify the certificate transaction (issuance, transfer or cancellation) to record.
Enter certificate number, holder name and share count into the ledger.
Confirm the transaction type is correctly classified.
Done when the transaction is recorded in the ledger.
verify: Open the ledger entry and check completeness.
Pass when certificate number, holder and share count are all correct.

steps.title: Cancel and retain surrendered certificate stubs
sop: Collect the surrendered certificate upon reissuance or transfer.
Cancel the certificate and retain the stub per procedure.
File the stub with the corresponding ledger entry.
Done when the surrendered stub is cancelled and retained.
verify: Locate the retained stub for the transaction.
Pass when the stub is present and marked cancelled.

steps.title: Reconcile total shares outstanding to authorized share count
sop: Pull total shares outstanding from the ledger.
Compare against the entity's authorized share count in its articles.
Investigate and resolve any variance.
Done when shares outstanding reconcile to the authorized count.
verify: Compare the ledger total to the articles' authorized count.
Pass when totals agree or the variance is explained and approved.

steps.title: Confirm ownership ledger matches Finance's intercompany equity records
sop: Pull the intercompany equity records maintained by Finance.
Compare against the corresponding entries in the ownership ledger.
Resolve any discrepancy with Finance before finalizing.
Done when the ledger matches Finance's intercompany records.
verify: Compare ledger entries to the Finance equity schedule.
Pass when both sources agree with no unresolved discrepancy.

steps.title: Store certificate images alongside ledger entries
sop: Scan the physical or retrieve the electronic certificate image.
Attach the image to the corresponding ledger entry in OpenText.
Confirm the image is legible and correctly linked.
Done when the certificate image is stored alongside the ledger entry.
verify: Open the ledger entry and confirm the attached image.
Pass when the image is present, legible and correctly linked.

steps.title: Sample test ledger transactions for accuracy
sop: Select 10 certificate transactions recorded in the period.
Confirm each reconciles to authorized shares and Finance records.
Log any exception with a remediation owner.
Done when the sample is reviewed and exceptions logged.
verify: Review sample results against source records.
Pass when 100% reconcile or have a logged remediation owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All external and regulatory requests for certified board minute extracts
generic.In-scope period: Extract requests received in the current filing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requester, meeting date, agenda item and certification fields completed
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extract request log count matches issued extracts on file
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certified extract retained with issue date and recipient
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any extract not matching the source minute logged and corrected before issuance
generic.Test population: Sample of 8 extracts issued in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100% of sampled extracts match the source minute exactly
generic.Exception handling path: Return to Legal Secretary for correction before re-issuance
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certified extract matches the source minute and is logged with requester and issue date
generic.Evidence location: Secretarial filings register and OpenText extract folder

steps.title: Pull the exact board minute excerpt for the request
